gateways.name: New Chitose Airport
gateways.notes: Primary international gateway to Hokkaido. ~2h45m by bus to Niseko.

gateways.name: Sapporo Station
gateways.notes: Use as a stopover for a night or two in Sapporo en route to Niseko.

gateways.name: Kutchan Station
gateways.notes: Closest JR Hakodate Main Line station to Hirafu (~10 min by taxi). Future shinkansen terminus (Hokkaido Shinkansen extension, est. 2030+).

gateways.name: Niseko Station
gateways.notes: JR station serving Niseko town and Annupuri base; small, limited service.

routes.to: Niseko hotel pickup (Hirafu / Hanazono / Village / Annupuri)
routes.frequency: 5-8 departures per day in peak season
routes.notes: Reserved-seat door-to-door coach. Book online in advance; sells out on busy weekends.
Alternative shuttle operator with similar pricing and routes.
Public express bus; cheaper, fewer stops. Runs December–March.
Airport Rapid runs every 15 min. Covered by JR Hokkaido Rail Pass.
Scenic but slow; usually requires a transfer at Otaru. Not recommended with bulky ski gear.
Winter tyres and 4WD are mandatory. International Driving Permit required for non-Japanese licenses. Allow extra time in storms.

in_resort_transport.name: Niseko United Shuttle
in_resort_transport.notes: Free shuttle connecting all four Niseko United bases. Covered by All-Mountain pass holders.

in_resort_transport.name: Hirafu Village Shuttle (Night Bus)
in_resort_transport.notes: Free loop around upper and lower Hirafu village for restaurants and the Welcome Center.

in_resort_transport.name: Niseko Taxi / Kutchan Hire
in_resort_transport.notes: Limited fleet; book at least 1 hour ahead on weekend evenings.
